verdict.rationale: Ramp documents automation that spans many items at once — automatic categorization and ERP sync applied across all transactions, bulk spend exports with 'SQL-style analysis' via MCP, CSV exports, and CLI/API resources (transactions list/edit, bills search/approve) that support scripting over many records. However there is no explicit documented bulk/batch endpoint (e.g., a single call to approve or edit N transactions/bills at once); bulk-like behavior relies on scripting individual calls or platform-side automation rather than a dedicated bulk-operations primitive. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API or CLI command operating on multiple IDs in one call, documented bulk approval/edit endpoint, independent evidence of large-scale bulk actions in practice.
